findingDispositions.boundsAndFate: The v1 proof bound is 64 relations x two activated semantic universes = 128 keys per stage, below one 4096-entry Coverage frame. Checked arithmetic never wraps, truncates or samples. A count above 128 or uint64 overflow is a pre-spawn host invariant failure, operational-failed / SYSTEM.OUTCOME.ILLEGAL_STATE, with no fabricated Coverage.
